open_questions: exact script argument order for the *Set family (the dispatcher is one giant if-else chain over parsed tokens; argument order was inferred from the call sequence, not from a single linear parse function)
DEPTH values of the UIPanel fields (blockPanel/actionPanel/renderPanel/systemPanel) are serialized in the prefab, not present as literals

the mapping from 'chara index letters' (A-Z) to slot numbers is ConvertCharaIndex = ((c-'A') | (acc<<8)) i.e. multi-letter names map to multi-byte ints; the per-slot default depth/layer come from the prefab
the exact z/depth ordering between pictureFrame, chara and foreground effects could not be pinned to numeric values except PICTURE_FRAME_Z_POS_NORMAL/TOP

command boundaries inside ScriptCommandExecute are a compiler-generated switch tree: the 'code right after a comparison' is not always that command's body; per-command bodies in this doc were accepted only when the following call sequence was coherent (Convert* + Set* with the parsed argument)
